newsDocuments.headline: Govt cuts petrol price by Rs3.63, increases diesel's by Re0.31 per litre

segments.text: Pakistan government on Thursday reduced the price of petrol by Rs3.63 to Rs390.23 per litre, while increasing the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Re0.31 to Rs396.96 per litre, effective for Friday, October 16, 2026.

According to a press release issued by the Petroleum Division, the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) revised the ex-depot prices of petroleum products under the federal government’s petroleum pricing mechanism.
The Petroleum Division said the change was necessitated by global events, including changes in Platts rates, premiums and incidentals.

newsDocuments.headline: Oil prices slips as US weighs easing sanctions on 'shadow fleet'

segments.text: LONDON: Brent crude prices fell over 1% on Thursday as potential US steps to ease restrictions on Russia’s “shadow fleet” tankers soothed price concerns, but attacks on ships in the Middle East and Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy infras

The international benchmark lost $1.15, or 1.1%, to $104.91 a barrel by 1157 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures were up marginally by 31 cents, or 0.3%, to $95.40, amid expectations for a large draw in weekly inventories.

Oil prices fell after a US official said on Wednesday that the US administration was considering easing sanctions on some of Russia’s unregulated tankers, a move that could help lower freight rates and increase flexibility in diesel shipmen

newsDocuments.headline: Kremlin accuses Ukraine of flouting spirit of US peace efforts with strikes on Russian oil refineries

segments.text: MOSCOW: The Kremlin on Thursday said that Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries ran counter to US peace efforts, after a Ukrainian drone struck a refinery in Russia’s Ryazan region overnight.
US President Trump declared an energy ceasefire on Sunday, something Ukraine said it had first learnt about from media reports and which Russia did not publicly commit itself to.
Kyiv said it had paused strikes on Russian oil refineries for three days, but had resumed them after Russia continued to attack Ukraine’s energy sector.
